$comment: Multi-layer tube page: section order, visibility and style (OPEX: product.tube.page → layout). Built-in sections: hero (media | compact), configurator (viewerStart | viewerEnd), samples (grid | rail), quote, structure (split | stacked), cta (the closing call to action; hidden = footer only). Page-builder blocks (richText, imageText, cta, faq, form, spacer) can go anywhere with their own props.
